statements.text: The shortest shadow on a day marks when the Sun is highest in the sky.
The time from the shortest shadow on day 1 to the shortest shadow on day 2 is nearly 24 hours.
The longest shadow on a day marks when the Sun is highest in the sky.

stem:
Tia plants a vertical stick on the playground and marks the tip of its shadow through two school days. She wants to measure one day of nearly 24 hours.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Shortest shadow marks the Sun's highest position; spacing those marks on successive days measures nearly 24 hours. The longest shadow is not noon, so statement 3 is false.
